title: Cyborg City Under Jaundiced Sky
summary: In a notorious Greek-inspired city, cyborgs strafe as a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass, and oil-stained mechanic coveralls secures a mysterious kenaf package, feeling woozy. She navigates a kitschy bowling alley, an undisputed jock, reciting a haiku about privacy, dodging deadliest threats. Later, she empowers a clunky, cobweb-laden catapult, facing markups of fealty and fat backup forces. A nephron-like device pulsates, ready to horrify the infinity of approaching junkets. Finally, a demolished octagon glows among mountains. Her coveralls remain, a quiet squeeze after the injury, signifying payback and earned peace.
protagonist: a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls

scenes.sentence: A notorious city under a jaundiced sky, where cyborgs strafe, and a teenager secures a mysterious package.
scenes.prompt: Wide establishing shot of a notorious, heavily fortified Greek-inspired city under a jaundiced sky. Madcaps and heavyset cyborgs strafe through the streets, their volleys of energy dampening the last glimmers of light. In the foreground, a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, and oil-stained mechanic coveralls knowingly secures a mysterious kenaf package, a heartless juggernaut looming in the distance. The air is thick with the scent of ginger and truffle, making her woozy as dinner preparations for the hearts of the city are jammed.

scenes.sentence: Branded and bashful, she moves through a kitschy bowling alley, an undisputed jock, avoiding deadly threats.
scenes.prompt: Medium shot of the teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, and oil-stained mechanic coveralls, now branded and fairly bashful, navigating a kitschy, animation-infused bowling alley. She's the undisputed jock, her every move jinxing the competition. The barkeep, a folkway figure, pours whiskey. Around her, turkeys strut in the background, oblivious to the deadliest threat. She recites a haiku about privacy under a tobacco-stained sky, feeling a bold surge of adrenaline, avoiding being lynched by a looming threat to her jugular.

scenes.sentence: She desperately empowers a clunky catapult, an upsurge of glowing energy ready to horrify the approaching forces.
scenes.prompt: Tight close-up on the teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, and oil-stained mechanic coveralls, her face reflecting the trippy, wackier patterns of a clunky, cobweb-laden catapult mechanism she’s desperately trying to empower. An upsurge of power glows around her hands as she prepares to give it everything, aware that markups of fealty and fat backup forces are closing in. A single, glowing nephron-like device pulsates near her jockstrap, ready to horrify the infinity of the approaching junkets. She smears sunblock on her face, bracing for the Wuthering stuff.

scenes.sentence: The aftermath of demolition, an octagon glowing, with only her coveralls left among the mountains.
scenes.prompt: Wide, overhead shot revealing a demolished dinky octagon structure, now glowing with a strange energy, nestled among snow-capped mountains. The ground is crusty, dotted with the remnants of an odd dodo, and discarded wrenches. The teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, and oil-stained mechanic coveralls is nowhere to be seen, only her oil-stained mechanic coveralls draped over a nearby rock. Lowkey, a trainer is visible in the distance, his ears perked, observing the scene. The air smells of adulterated alcohol, signifying the payback, a quiet squeeze after the injury in the kitchen. She will earn her peace.
